# volblocksize: power of 2 at create, readonly after (set, clone -o, inherit)
# covers: resv-auto
zfs create -s -V 1000000 -o volblocksize=3000 $R/v
zfs create -V 67108864 -o volblocksize=8192 $R/v
zfs set volblocksize=16384 $R/v
zfs snapshot $R/v@s1
zfs clone -o volblocksize=16384 $R/v@s1 $R/x
zfs inherit volblocksize $R/v
